|game_text=If your starting location was a system, ▼ a related site (must be a battleground if the system is a non-battleground or Endor) with < 3 [Light Side Force] icons and up to three Effects that are always [Immune to Alter]. Place this Interrupt in Lost Pile.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E3 (version 3 of 4, after a lost first printing). The image here is a CardMaker recreation of this text (no published image shows it; made 11 November 2026) ([[:File:VB4-93E-Careful_Planning-PC-E3-cardmaker.png]]). The current text is [[Careful Planning (V) (Virtual Block 4) (Errata 4)]] (PC-E4), the Master List of 27 April 2013.
* '''First printing''' (September 2009): lost. The card was first issued when the Players Committee realigned its Virtual Sets into Virtual Blocks in September 2009. No copy of that first printing survives, so its text is not known and it has no page here (versions ruling of 11 November 2026).
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Careful Planning (V) (Virtual Block 4) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB4-L-carefulplanning-pre.gif]], slip number 94E, errata mark E) prints: “If your starting location was a system, ▼ a related site (must be a battleground if the system is a non-battleground or Endor) with < 3 [Light Side Force] icons and up to three Effects that are always [Immune to Alter]. Place this Interrupt in Lost Pile.” The same image is in Lee Edwards' V-kit, committed on 9 December 2009<ref name="vkit-2009">Lee Edwards' V-kit, [https://github.com/ledwards/swccgvkit-legacy/tree/81e004826e5697f45d10c4330f78ff8136dae46f/public/images/vslips swccgvkit-legacy <code>public/images/vslips</code>] (commit 81e0048, migrated from svn on 28 May 2010; the <code>.svn/entries</code> files record svn r1 committed 2009-12-09T05:41:52Z for these slips). The file <code>virtual8-light/carefulplanning.png</code> is the same image as the Players Committee card image (same words, slip number and errata mark), compared by eye on 11 November 2026.</ref>, so it was made by then. The PC website card list stamps the card “Errata Text - September 9th, 2009”; this wording is that errata of 9 September 2009 (versions ruling of 11 November 2026, as for the H1 cards, e.g. [[Away Put Your Weapon (V)]]). It is the earliest surviving text of the card. The PC website's image folder carries the same file with the server date 25 February 2013, a later bulk upload of the unchanged image. Document: the PC card image is a whole card (art, title bar, lore, icons, frame and set mark) and prints the number “94E” bottom right (the release-sheet slip has “93E”).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Careful Planning (V) (Virtual Block 4) (Errata 2)]]): Virtual Block 4 release sheet, official text as of 7 December 2009<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf#page=10 Virtual Block 4 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"; copy re-made 20 April 2010), page 10, slip 93E. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095223/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf#page=10 Internet Archive]</ref>: “If your starting location was a system, ▼ a related site (must be a battleground if the system is a non-battleground or Endor) with < 3 [Light Side Force] and up to three Effects that are always [Immune to Alter]. Place this Interrupt in Lost Pile.” '''What changed:''' “icons” is dropped (“with < 3 [Light Side Force] and up to three”). Document: the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB4-93E-Careful_Planning.png]]) prints slip number “93E” bottom right.
* '''PC-E3''' (this page): PC website card list, Virtual Block list and Virtual master list, in every archived capture with game text, 21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013<ref name="cl-1240_94">Players Committee website card list (Internet Archive captures): VBlock4Type (Virtual Block 4 list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064721/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001437/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 12 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111144021/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 11 January 2013]; VMasterType (Virtual master list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211203905/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 January 2013]. Later captures carry no game text.</ref>: “If your starting location was a system, ▼ a related site (must be a battleground if the system is a non-battleground or Endor) with < 3 [Light Side Force] icons and up to three Effects that are always [Immune to Alter]. Place this Interrupt in Lost Pile.” '''What changed:''' “icons” is back (“with < 3 [Light Side Force] icons and up to three”), the same words as PC-E1. The list adds the credit line “(Errata Text - September 9th, 2009)”. The Players Committee generated the website card list from its Holotable card data, so this wording is that data's transcription of the card; the Players Committee published it on its own website, so it is a version. Icons written out in words, straight single quotes and credit lines in the list are not changes; the text here draws the icons as the printed slips do. The list shows no slip image.
* '''PC-E4''' ([[Careful Planning (V) (Virtual Block 4) (Errata 4)]]): Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 32)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=32 Internet Archive]</ref>, slip [[:File:VL-history-1240-94-front-master.png]]: “If your starting location was a system, ▼ a related site (must be a battleground if the system is a non-battleground or Endor) with < 3 [Light Side Force] and up to three Effects that are always [Immune to Alter]. Place this Interrupt in Lost Pile.” '''What changed:''' the Master List prints the release-sheet words of 7 December 2009 (PC-E2) again, word for word (no “icons”). It is the last publication, so it is the current text; it is listed as its own version because it was published (versions rulings of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat; whatever was published last is current). Document: the Master List slip prints no slip number, only the errata mark “E” bottom right.
